## Topics
- Binary outcomes and log odds
- Fitting glm(family = binomial)
- Crude and adjusted odds ratios
- Train/test splits and cross-validation
- Ethics: algorithmic bias in health prediction

## Learning objectives
By the end of this module you should be able to:

- Fit a logistic regression and report odds ratios with CIs
- Present crude and adjusted ORs side by side
- Evaluate predictions on held-out data
- Describe how a prediction model can treat groups unfairly

## Data
NHANES: diabetes ~ age + BMI + physical activity
